desc: 蓝调清爽详情页套图：首屏卖点、功能图标、痛点放大、护理场景、微距与参数收口
name: 宠物除臭消毒喷雾蓝净款

shots.intent: 一秒传达除臭去味核心卖点，用清爽蓝调与宠物陪伴建立第一眼信任
shots.textZone: 顶部三分之一白色粗体大标题加黄色荧光笔下划线，其下一行三枚细线圆形图标与短标签

shots.intent: 以 2x3 细线图标矩阵快速讲清产品功能结构，承接首屏兴趣
shots.textZone: 面板左侧竖排小标题区，面板内 2x3 图标网格短标签区

shots.intent: 用巨型数字背景与三枚胶囊标签放大宠物三大困扰，制造问题共鸣
shots.textZone: 下方一行三枚蓝胶囊标签区，附灰色英文小字副标

shots.intent: 以专业护理人宠互动场景让买家自我投射，建立温和安心的使用联想
shots.textZone: 左上两行白色标题区加黄色荧光笔下划线，配三个黄色圆点短标签

shots.intent: 用 2x2 卡片把日常接触场景的隐患逐条可视化，强化购买紧迫感
shots.textZone: 居中两行大标题加黄色下划线与一行灰色副标，每卡片一枚蓝胶囊标签与一行说明

shots.intent: 以左右交替卡片逐条解析困扰成因，把问题过渡到产品机制解释
shots.textZone: 每卡片一枚深蓝胶囊标签与一行灰色说明，图区左右交替

shots.intent: 用仰拍微距展示细腻喷雾与瓶身质感，证明使用体验与工艺
shots.textZone: 下三分之一处一枚白色小标签

shots.intent: 以结构化参数表消除规格与适用范围疑虑，回答买不买得对
shots.textZone: 两列参数表：粗体深灰行标签加短值，顶部「产品信息」大标题区

shots.intent: 以人宠同框与瓶身材质细节收口，用真实可感的使用画面降低决策风险
shots.textZone: 上方一行三枚细线圆形图标与短标签，底部一枚深蓝胶囊短标签

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio backdrops alternating pure white #FFFFFF sections and soft sky-blue #6FA8DC bands with rounded pale-blue #C9DFF2 info cards
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline icons, 2px stroke, flat single-color white or deep blue #4A7EBB
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused daylight, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, airy clean mood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh clean pet-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, soft sky blue #6FA8DC, pale blue panel #C9DFF2, one lemon-yellow highlighter accent #F2D22E, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; cool temperature; seamless studio backdrops alternating white sections and rounded blue panels; bright soft diffused daylight with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with yellow highlighter underline; thin-line circular outline icons with 2px stroke; stable product scale with upright bottle placement and pet companion at right; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: bottle upright centered or offset-left at stable scale, pet companion seated at right, consistent 3/4 hero angle across scenes
style.surfaceSystem: seamless studio backdrop only, no hard tabletop, products grounded by soft contact shadow
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold rounded headlines in #2D2D2D or #FFFFFF with lemon-yellow #F2D22E highlighter underline, short labels only
